fusions.name: Gagging Grip
fusions.desc: Silences one enemy within 7 tiles for 3 seconds and deals 8 damage, taking its next action away and knocking it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Taught Gesture
fusions.desc: Gestures a bolt up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5 tiles (max +32%).

fusions.name: Mimed Mantra
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4s after you use it.

fusions.name: Repeated Word
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. Your armour rises by 10%.
